parsed.name: MC1电机控制器
parsed.description: MC1是一种用于驱动和定位线性执行器的电机控制器，可设置步进增量、行程上下限，并执行居中、复位和定点移动等操作。在实验室中，它可用于对位置进行重复扫描与调整，常见于配合线性执行器进行Hong–Ou–Mandel（HOM）干涉谷测量等实验。
parsed.description_en: The MC1 is a motor controller used to drive and position a linear actuator. It supports step increment control, travel limits, centering, reset, and point-to-point motion. In the lab, it is used for repeatable position scanning and adjustment, such as operating a linear actuator for Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) dip measurements.
